issue.title: Native AAC→M4A remux module (MediaMuxer) for seekable Review scrubbing
issue.body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #176 / PR #231. The JS remux seam (`ensureSeekableTakeUri`) is landed; this issue covers the **Android native** Expo CNG local module that remuxes committed ADTS `.aac` into seekable `.m4a` via `MediaMuxer`, plus device QA for Review scrubbing.

## Context

#176 AC requires a committed take to become a seekable M4A and accurate Review scrubbing. PR #231 only injects an optional `RemuxNativeModule` and keeps `.aac` playable when the module is absent. Full AC remains open on #176 with a ticket-level waiver pointing here.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Expo local/native module (Android-only, CNG) wrapping `MediaMuxer` (or equivalent) for ADTS AAC → M4A remux
- Wire module into `ensureSeekableTakeUri` / `RemuxNativeModule` injection
- Android device QA: record (ADTS path) → commit → Review scrub to multiple positions

**Out of scope**
- Changing kill-safe ADTS capture format
- JS seam already in #231

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Native remux module converts committed `.aac` to seekable `.m4a` with `moov`
- [ ] Injected into app so `ensureSeekableTakeUri` remuxes on commit
- [ ] Review scrubbing seeks accurately on the remuxed file
- [ ] Remux failure leaves original AAC playable (no data loss)
- [ ] Android device QA recorded on the implementing PR

## Links

- Parent: #176
- JS seam PR: #231
- Refs #49 (Review scrubbing deferred from Record Tab)
